about.text: Fermented camel's milk of the Somali herders of eastern Ethiopia, left to sour on its own in a clean or smoked container; the smoke, from woods such as wild olive, helps it keep.

links.name: Seifu, Livestock Research for Rural Development (2007)

how.label: ferment in smoked can
how.text: Ethiopian Somali dhanaan is raw camel milk soured in a smoked, cloth-wrapped container. Streptococcus, Lactococcus and Weissella dominate the lactic flora, which gives a thin, sour drink, often topped up with fresh milk.
